'''Bree''' was the shortened nickname of a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. She ran a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[Port Town (Cloud City)/Legends|Port Town]] district of the [[City/Legends|city]], known as the ''[[Four-and-a-Half]]'', which was located illegally between levels in a utility space. None of her clientele knew Bree's full name, and she was considered slimy by many.<ref name="TJoY" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bree first appeared in ''[[The Jewel of Yavin]]'', an adventure module released for ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' in [[2014]] by [[Fantasy Flight Games]]. She is listed as a character players might encounter, although no specific interaction is described.
